nodes.description: address payable admin; marketplace administrator receiving commission payments
address contract_owner; privileged owner allowed to update admin/commission/mint settings
uint256 commissionRate (0-100) applied to sale and auction amounts
mapping(uint256 => uint256) soldFor; last price a token was sold for
mapping(uint256 => uint256) sellBidPrice; fixed sell price or last bid for a token
mapping(uint256 => address payable) _wallets; payment destination for a token sale
mapping(uint256 => Auction) auctions; per-token auction state (beneficiary, end, highestBidder, highestBid, open, reserve)
bool anyoneCanMint; toggles open minting in ERC721Mintable
External caller address controlling owner/buyer/bidder authorization paths
block timestamp (now) used for auction deadline checks
Transaction origin; not used in authorization but treated as untrusted input
sell(uint256,uint256,address payable): owner lists token at fixed price, approves contract and sets payout wallet
buy(uint256) payable nonReentrant: buys a listed NFT, transfers NFT, pays seller wallet and admin commission
createAuction(uint256,uint,address payable,uint256): owner opens an auction, approves contract for token
bid(uint256) payable nonReentrant: places a higher bid, refunds previous highest bidder via low-level call
withdraw(uint256) nonReentrant: refunds highest bidder and deletes auction when conditions met
auctionFinalize(uint256) nonReentrant: pays beneficiary/admin, transfers NFT to highest bidder, deletes auction
updateAdmin(address payable,uint256,bool): contract_owner updates admin, commissionRate, anyoneCanMint
callOptionalReturn(IERC721,bytes): performs low-level call to transferFrom with optional return decoding
canBid(uint256): view helper checking auction open, timestamp, non-contract bidder, approval
canWithdraw(uint256): view helper determining whether an unfinalized auction can be withdrawn
canFinalize(uint256): view helper determining whether auction ended and reserve was met
transfer(address,uint256): ERC721Full helper calling internal _transferFrom for msg.sender
autoMint(string,address): mints with auto-incremented tokenId and sets token URI
Low-level _wallets[tokenId].call.value(amount4owner) ether transfer to seller wallet in buy()
Low-level admin.call.value(amount4admin) ether transfer of commission in buy()
Low-level highestBidder.call.value(highestBid) refund of previous bidder in bid()
Low-level highestBidder.call.value(highestBid) refund in withdraw()
Low-level beneficiary.call.value(amount4owner) ether transfer in auctionFinalize()
Low-level admin.call.value(amount4admin) commission transfer in auctionFinalize()
address(token).call(data) low-level external call inside callOptionalReturn
Arithmetic computations value.mul(commissionRate).div(100) and value.sub(amount4admin) for payout splitting
uint256 tokenId parameter of sell()
uint256 price parameter of sell()
address payable wallet parameter of sell() stored in _wallets
uint _closingTime parameter of createAuction() (auctionEnd)
address payable _beneficiary parameter of createAuction()
uint256 _reservePrice parameter of createAuction()
address payable _admin parameter of updateAdmin()
uint256 _commissionRate parameter of updateAdmin()
bool _anyoneCanMint parameter of updateAdmin()
Local uint256 amount4admin holding computed commission payout
Local uint256 amount4owner holding computed remainder payout to seller
Local address payable highestBidder snapshot in auctionFinalize()

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal contract_owner to update admin parameters
sell() requires ownerOf(tokenId)==msg.sender before listing
createAuction() requires ownerOf(tokenId)==msg.sender to open auction
msg.sender is the buyer used in transferFrom and ownership checks in buy()
msg.sender becomes highestBidder and must not be token owner or a contract
canBid relies on now <= auctionEnd, creating timestamp dependency
canWithdraw relies on now >= auctionEnd, creating timestamp dependency
canFinalize relies on now >= auctionEnd, creating timestamp dependency
bid() requires now <= auctionEnd before accepting a bid
auctionFinalize() requires now >= auctionEnd before finalizing
commissionRate is multiplied/divided to derive payout amounts
sell() writes sellBidPrice[tokenId]
buy() reads sellBidPrice[tokenId] for price validation and clears it
_wallets[tokenId] is the target of the low-level payout in buy()
admin address receives commission via low-level call in buy()
admin address receives commission via low-level call in auctionFinalize()
auctions[tokenId].highestBidder is refunded via low-level call in bid()
auctions[tokenId].highestBidder is refunded via low-level call in withdraw()
auctions[tokenId].beneficiary is paid via low-level call in auctionFinalize()
bid() reads and writes auctions[tokenId] bid state
withdraw() reads auctions[tokenId] then deletes it
auctionFinalize() reads auctions[tokenId] and deletes it at the end
buy() writes soldFor[tokenId] with msg.value
auctionFinalize() writes soldFor[tokenId] with highestBid
tokenId parameter selects the token being sold
price parameter sets sellBidPrice[tokenId]
wallet parameter is stored as the sale payout address
_closingTime parameter sets auctions[tokenId].auctionEnd
_beneficiary parameter sets auctions[tokenId].beneficiary
_reservePrice parameter sets auctions[tokenId].reserve
_admin parameter overwrites the admin state variable
_commissionRate parameter overwrites the commissionRate state variable
_anyoneCanMint parameter overwrites the anyoneCanMint state variable
amount4admin is computed via mul/div on commissionRate
amount4owner is computed via subtraction from msg.value
local highestBidder snapshot is used for NFT transfer in auctionFinalize()
buy() invokes callOptionalReturn to perform transferFrom of the NFT
auctionFinalize() invokes callOptionalReturn to transfer the NFT to the bidder
buy() sends ether to the seller wallet with a low-level call that can reenter before state is finalized
buy() sends commission to admin via low-level call after external payout, enabling reentrant state read
bid() refunds the previous highest bidder before recording the new bid, allowing reentrancy
withdraw() refunds the highest bidder before deleting the auction, allowing reentrancy
auctionFinalize() pays the beneficiary before transferring the NFT and deleting auction state
auctionFinalize() pays admin commission via low-level call before finalizing auction state
callOptionalReturn performs an arbitrary low-level call to the token contract whose receiver hook may reenter

_reservePrice parameter is only meaningful within createAuction()

_commissionRate parameter is only meaningful within updateAdmin()
